addons.name: Yogi Calculations - Formulas and Variables for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Insert calculations, formulas, and variables in Confluence pages and measure estimates, project progress and more
addons.summary: Yogi Calculations lets you insert math formulas, reusable variables, all into Confluence. Made to help you estimate budgets, key indicators of your project’s success, and build fact-checked reports.

addons.name: Space Crafter: Cloning & Variables
addons.tagLine: Streamline your Confluence with Space Crafter: clone spaces, create dynamic templates, and manage variables effortlessly
addons.summary: Cloning & Variables optimizes your Confluence with effortless space cloning, template-based page creation, and efficient property variable management. Utilize property variables throughout your space and manage them via the property variables panel.

addons.name: Dynamic Variables for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Dynamic Variables simplifies Confluence content by enabling reusable variables with real-time preview
addons.summary: Dynamic Variables for Confluence lets you create, manage, and reuse content across pages. Define personal and global variables, use system values, and insert them easily with real-time preview.

addons.name: Advanced Codeblocks for Confluence
addons.tagLine: The App renders and visualizes different codeblocks with replaced variables based on your templates from any source
addons.summary: Extend your Atlassian Confluence with Advanced Codeblocks. The App renders and visualizes different codeblocks with replaced variables based on your templates from any source.

addons.name: Variants for Scroll Content Manager
addons.tagLine: Manage conditional content and publish variants of your documentation based on audience needs
addons.summary: Manage conditional content and publish variants of your documentation based on audience needs.

addons.name: Space Properties & Fields
addons.tagLine: Manage space properties and centralize common metadata, variables, metrics in custom fields for reuse or tracking or automation
addons.summary: Simple App to Manage space field properties and centralize the common metadata, variables, strings, tokens in fields for reuse, tracking and automation. These fields can be accessed or shared among many confluence pages via macro "Space fields".

addons.name: MultiExcerpt
addons.tagLine: Create, update, and share multiple excerpts across pages and spaces. Streamline document management by avoiding copy and paste
addons.summary: With MultiExcerpt, you can create, update, and share multiple excerpts across pages and spaces, maintaining information consistency and reducing time spent on manual copying and pasting.

addons.name: Page Tree Creator Pro (Blueprint, Template)
addons.tagLine: Create & manage advanced page trees with templates & placeholders, Pro features for scale, control & more - Coming to Forge
addons.summary: Wasting time while trying to duplicate and recreate templates, blueprints and complex page trees, only to repeat the tedious process again?

addons.name: External Data for Confluence (Visualize Database & API Data)
addons.tagLine: Visualize external data as table or charts from Salesforce, SharePoint, Airtable, HubSpot, Snowflake, SQL databases or REST APIs
addons.summary: Visualize external data as tables, charts or templates on Confluence pages. Connect to your REST API,  database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Db2 or MSSQL), Salesforce, Azure or Okta.

addons.name: Linking for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Create and manage structured content using templates, renaming titles, and linking between pages
addons.summary: Linking provides you macros to create “one-click” links that generate structured content via templates, easily manage your links to multiple resources and create naming conventions for your content.

addons.name: ConfiFields smart dynamic fields for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Centrally managed values and variables in Confluence cloud
addons.summary: With ConfiFields smart dynamic fields for Confluence app you can store centrally managed values and variables in Confluence cloud

addons.name: Space Copier for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Create Confluence spaces from template spaces, with variables filled in
addons.summary: Turn any Confluence space into a template. Create a new space from it in a minute: pages in the same order, attachments, labels, page restrictions and blog posts, with {{Client}} and other variables replaced. Or copy any space. Runs on Atlassian.

addons.name: Viable Issues – Create better issues for Jira in Confluence
addons.tagLine: Place buttons to create pre-configured Jira issues from Confluence pages—streamline workflows and improve focus
addons.summary: Create Jira tickets from any Confluence page with "Create issue" buttons. Preconfigure key fields so every ticket follows the same workflow—saving time and boosting clarity for meetings, projects, and teams on both Cloud and Data Center.

addons.name: Page Pipeline for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Workflow with validator, variable, screen and post-function actions including review and approval transition
addons.summary: Empowers teams to build custom page approval pipelines with a visual drag-and-drop canvas. Define statuses, connect transitions, and attach post-functions like automated comments, label assignments, page restrictions, and webhook calls.

addons.name: Publish to Cloud for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Use Confluence as a headless CMS for websites by publishing pages directly to a cloud service like GitHub, Amazon S3 and Zapier
addons.summary: Use Confluence as a headless CMS for websites by publishing pages directly to a cloud service like GitHub, Amazon S3 and Zapier. Apply templates so published pages match the styles of your website. Multiple prize winner in Atlassian Codegeist 2022.

addons.name: Truth Tables for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Truth Tables for Confluence: Simplify and structure complex logic with ease
addons.summary: Truth Tables for Confluence simplifies business logic by enabling users to create clear, structured truth tables directly in Atlassian Confluence.

addons.name: Macro Studio for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Bring User Macros back to Confluence Cloud — admin-defined custom macros every author can reuse
addons.summary: Data Center had User Macros; Cloud removed them. Macro Studio brings them back: admins define HTML/CSS macros with typed variables, authors insert them like built-in macros, and every render is sanitized. Includes a Data Center macro importer.
